title: World Action Critic (WAC) Model: Joint Foresight and Criticism for Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models have shown considerable promise in sequential decision-making by anticipating the consequences of actions and providing predictive foresight for policy learning. However, learning to reason about counterfactual actions remains challenging, since predictive objectives may underemphasize information critical for action evaluation, while unexecuted actions lack observed futures for direct supervision. To address these challenges, we propose the World Action Critic (WAC) Model, which proposes multimodal action candidates and jointly learns candidate-conditioned future prediction and consequence evaluation. In our proposed framework, critic supervision directly shapes intermediate predictive representations during rollout, encouraging them to retain information needed to distinguish action quality. translated_title: 世界动作评论家模型：面向策略学习的联合前瞻与评判
translated_abstract: 世界模型通过预测动作的后果并为策略学习提供预测性前瞻，在序列决策中展现出相当大的潜力。然而，学习对反事实动作进行推理仍然具有挑战性，因为预测目标可能低估对动作评估至关重要的信息，而未执行的动作又缺乏可观察的未来以进行直接监督。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了世界动作评论家（WAC）模型，该模型生成多模态动作候选，并联合学习以候选为条件的未来预测与后果评估。在我们提出的框架中，评论家监督在推演过程中直接塑造中间预测表示，促使其保留区分动作质量所需的信息。可观察的未来用于监督已执行动作的预测，而外部任务质量目标则为反事实动作提供评估信号。
tldr: 提出世界动作评论家（WAC）模型，通过联合学习动作候选的未来预测与后果评估，并利用评论家监督直接塑造预测表示，从而实现对反事实动作的有效推理，提升策略学习效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes the World Action Critic (WAC) model, which jointly learns candidate-conditioned future prediction and consequence evaluation, using critic supervision to directly shape predictive representations for effective counterfactual action reasoning in policy learning.
